opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must be an established independent researcher with a permanent or fixed‑term UK university or not‑for‑profit position, able to lead interdisciplinary collaboration across Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Supports established researchers to pursue interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven projects across the social sciences, humanities, engineering and natural sciences, with up to 24 months of funding.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any UK‑based researcher (early‑career to senior) in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit, with prior public‑engagement experience.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £8,000 for innovative public‑engagement projects with a GLAM or performing‑arts partner, running between April 2027 and December 2028.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers based at UK or German institutions, working in humanities or social sciences, with interest in interdisciplinary collaboration on the theme ‘Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future’.
opportunities.summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities and social sciences can attend a three‑day symposium in April 2027; travel, accommodation and visa costs are covered.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences who have completed their doctorate between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027, not holding a permanent UK academic post, and based at a UK university or research organisation.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships to support independent research leading to a significant publishable output; the Academy funds 80 % of salary costs.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers with a long‑term appointment at a UK university or independent research organisation, working in the humanities or social sciences, wishing to develop new quantitative, data‑science, digital‑humanities or language skills.
opportunities.summary: Supports skill‑development projects (6–12 months) with up to £10,000 to build methodological capacity and foster interdisciplinary approaches.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences, with an eligible UK university or research institute appointment, collaborating with overseas partners; PI must allocate at least 20 % of time to the project.
opportunities.summary: Two‑year interdisciplinary projects (up to £300k) on the theme of Mobilities, involving any SHAPE or STEM discipline, led by humanities/social sciences researchers.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, eligible for DSIT funding, who will be based at DGAP in Berlin.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships (up to £150k) to develop policy‑relevant research and networks in areas such as security, Indo‑European relations, technology and AI, hosted at DGAP.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months, who need support for disability‑related, caring or other additional needs.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £4,000 (or higher in exceptional cases) to cover equipment, caring costs, or support needed to make an application to a British Academy call.
